unit: membership-bounded vendor-ticker spell = maximal run of observed Daily rows on every expected NYSE session inside one continuous UNION-S&P1500 membership episode. Missing expected source session or a real S&P1500 non-membership hiatus terminates the spell. A continuous S&P600->S&P400->S&P500 promotion does not reset the spell.
identity_claim: Observable vendor-ticker spell only, not issuer/security continuity. Exact dot-to-dash vendor normalization is permitted; ambiguous/unresolved keys yield zero spells. Current aliases are never backdated.

rule_boundary.pre_outcome_use: Scientific owner may adopt this as the observational unit for the price-only retrospective first wave. Every unavailable member-date remains in source coverage; each config applies its declared warm-up/lookback only inside one spell.
rule_boundary.generic_thresholds_are_diagnostics_only: 20/60/126/200/252 counts are readiness diagnostics, not selected TOI hyperparameters or an admission decision.
not_proved: issuer/security continuity inside a ticker spell
rule_boundary.no_silent_join: Never bridge a source gap or S&P1500 non-membership hiatus after seeing outcomes.
